newsitem.title: USA: Pegasus Media buys Puerto Rican TV cable company.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus Media buys Puerto Rican TV cable company.

text.p: Pegasus Media & Communications Inc said it had bought a Puerto Rican cable television company for $26 million to expand its service on the island.
Pegasus said it had acquired the assets of DOMAR Inc, formerly known as Dom's TeleCable, which operates two cable television systems on the western part of the island.
It said it would incorporate DOMAR's systems into its own at Mayaquez, a town adjacent to the territory that the acquired company once served.
DOMAR had more than 16,000 customers in eight towns including San German and Cabo Rojo on the western part of the island, it added.

Pegasus said it would connect DOMAR's systems to its technical facilities in Mayaquez and improve the signal and increase the amount of channels offered to DOMAR's former customers. It would eventually introduce new Spanish-language networks to the service, it added.
Pegasus subsidiaries own and operate broadcast television stations that are affiliated to the FOX and UPN networks as well as cable television systems in the New England area.
